summary: Build employee wellness skills with needs assessment, ISO 45003, KPI dashboards, and evaluation exercises. Enquire about this five-day course.
lede: Employee health management programs use workforce needs and risk information to shape wellbeing initiatives. For occupational health managers, HR business partners, and wellbeing coordinators, this course develops practical skills to assess workforce needs, identify psychosocial hazards, prioritize interventions, and measure participation and outcomes using tools such as a risk register, KPI dashboard, and evaluation plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, operate, evaluate, or govern employee health and wellness programs across different organizational settings. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with workforce information, occupational health processes, employee support services, or organizational risk.
prerequisites: Working experience in HR, occupational health, workplace safety, employee assistance, health promotion, people analytics, or a related workforce function. You should be comfortable reviewing basic workforce metrics and discussing employee health data governance. No coding or programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted survey analysis are taught at operational application level, with human review and privacy controls.
